title: NVFP4 Group-16 File-Size Estimator — calibrated on PiD 1.5 FLUX.2
purpose: Reusable Python utility that estimates the expected file size of an NVFP4 group-16 quantized safetensors checkpoint from its bf16 original size. Calibrated against the BennyDaBall PiD 1.5 FLUX.2 NVFP4 card (1,091,499,246 bytes / 2.61 GB bf16 → 58.2% reduction, 15.4% of parameters kept in bf16). Useful for planning storage and download budgets before committing to a quantized checkpoint.
